name: { brain }
description: Private, offline-first second brain. Holds notes, links, code, ideas and quotes, each tagged and summarized. Other apps and agents connect through the owner's private GitHub Gist.

store.auth: GitHub token with the 'gist' scope, belonging to the brain's owner
store.discover: GET https://api.github.com/gists and pick the gist whose files include 'brain-data.json' (its description starts with '{ brain }')

file.deleted: array of entry ids deleted on any device; never re-add these
file.syncedAt: ISO 8601 time of the last write

entry.id: string, unique; prefix with your app name, e.g. 'tower-1760900000000-ab12'
entry.type: one of: text, link, code, idea, quote
entry.summary: string, at most 12 words, active voice
entry.timestamp: ISO 8601; last-write-wins on this field, so bump it when updating an entry
entry.source: optional string naming the app that wrote the entry; shown as 'via <source>'

rules: Read the gist, change it, and write it back in one step. Keep every entry and field you didn't create.
To add, append a new entry with a new id and your app name in 'source'.
To delete, remove the entry and add its id to 'deleted'.
Write back with PATCH https://api.github.com/gists/{id} and the whole file as files['brain-data.json'].content.
